2.en: And when the stars fall, scattering,

3.en: And when the seas are erupted

4.en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,

5.en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

6.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
6.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

7.en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

8.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
8.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

9.en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

10.en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

13.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

14.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

15.en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

16.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

17.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

18.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
18.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

19.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
19.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
